Description
Take this opportunity to own a piece of Canadian gold bullion history with the 2022 Royal Canadian Mint 1 oz Gold Maple Leaf Single Sourced Mine BU with Assay Card. This iconic gold coin is struck to the highest quality standard. It is sourced from a single mine, ensuring its authenticity and rarity. With its distinctive maple leaf design and guaranteed weight and purity, the Gold Maple Leaf is a preferred option for investors and collectors alike.
1 oz gold bullion coin from the Royal Canadian Mint (RCM) is widely known for its single-source mine origin. The Coin features the well-known Maple Leaf design. It is in Brilliant Uncirculated (BU) condition, meaning it has not been used or circulated and is in near-perfect condition. An assay card is included with the Coin, which serves as a certificate of authenticity and verifies the Coin’s weight, purity, and other details. The Gold Maple Leaf coin, produced in 2022, is valuable to any bullion collection.
Design of 1 oz Gold Maple Leaf 2022 RCM BU
1 oz Gold Maple Leaf bullion coin features the iconic Maple Leaf. This design has become a sign of Canadian national pride. It is recognized globally as a symbol of Canada’s rich history and natural beauty. The Coin’s obverse features a portrait of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II, a $50 face value, and 2022. The reverse side of the coin displays features a large maple leaf along with the weight and purity of the Coin. When magnified, a new micro-engraved maple leaf privy mark displays a “22.”.
The Gold used to produce this maple leaf coin is of the highest quality, with a purity of 99.99%. The Coin’s Brilliant, Uncirculated condition and its accompanying assay card certifying its weight and purity make it a highly collectible and valuable item for investors and collectors alike.
Main Highlights of 2022 1 oz Gold Maple Leaf 2022 RCM BU
The 1 oz Maple Leaf Gold Coin has 1 oz of .999 fine Gold.
The coins come with assay cards.
The assay certificate on the reverse of the card, which has the chief assayer’s signature, certifies the purity and authenticity of each Coin.
